description: NaClMgCl₂ is Ilmenite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with nine equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-58°. There are three shorter (2.72 Å) and three longer (2.86 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form MgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with nine equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-58°. There are three shorter (2.49 Å) and three longer (2.54 Å) Mg-Cl bond lengths. Cl is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms.
